prompt: Following a person and watching a repository are easy to mix up. Which sentence is correct?
explanation: Follow = feed content about a person or organization. Watch = notifications about a repository’s conversations. One is for staying inspired, the other for staying informed.

options.text: Following shapes your dashboard feed; watching subscribes you to a repository’s notifications
Following sends notifications; watching fills your feed
Both do exactly the same thing on different pages
Neither affects anything until you enable email
